snippet.description:
#indiegame #coopgaming #idlecraft
#rolltogether #indiegame  #coopgaming  

Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4791150/IdleCraft/

Idlecraft is a hover-to-act idlegame: sweep your cursor to mine ore and fight mobs as dusk falls, race your hunger and health, then spend every run's haul on a skill tree, enchants, gear, and prestige before diving into the next run.
